title: I could never thank you enough

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Solo: Lord, Your mercies are new with every sunrise
All: Your mercies are new with every sunrise

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Solo: To the name above all names, I lift my hands
All: You made all things yet chose to make me Your home
For Your spirit
I could never thank You enough

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: I’m the one who’s returned to say
Thank You, Lord, for every blessing;
The perfect understanding of the word You have given
Thank You for Your grace at work in me

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Solo:
Lord, Your life in me proves Your graciousness
All:
Yes, I’m a proof that You are gracious

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Solo:
In Your name, I trust, I know it never fails
All:
Wondrous Lord, Your truth is revealed in me
For Your goodness
I could never thank You enough

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: I’m the one who’s returned to say
Thank You, Lord, for every blessing
The perfect understanding of the word You have given
Thank You for Your grace at work in me

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Call:
I’ve seen Your kindness
And I’ve seen Your faithfulness
Response:
Thank you for Your grace at work in me

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: Call:
For the gift of Your spirit
And the gift of righteousness
Response:
Thank You for Your grace at work in me

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: Call:
For the great things that I wrought
In Your name and through Your word

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: Response:
Thank You for Your grace at work in me

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: Call:
For my transcendent life
In You Lord Jesus

slides.label: Verse 12
lines: Response:
Thank You for grace at work in me
